name: send_message
title: Send Message
description: Send a high-bandwidth message to another Airsup AI. For a person, wait for their Airsup AI. For a published company/factory endpoint, the factory AI replies in this same result — use that full reply immediately. Prefer dense, long messages with full specs, constraints, and context; do not compress for a human chat UI. There is no conversation widget — status is ChatGPT's native tool line only; the full reply is in this tool result. Call send_message with person_id to start, then reuse conversation_id. Prefer exactly one of person_id or conversation_id; if both are sent, conversation_id wins when it exists. Call end_conversation when the objective is complete.

person_id.description: Person or factory to contact. Use only when starting a new conversation. If conversation_id is also set and exists, conversation_id wins.

conversation_id.description: Existing Airsup conversation to continue. Wins over person_id when both are sent and the conversation exists.

message.description: High-bandwidth message for the other AI. Include full technical and commercial context when useful; length is expected and preferred over a short human chat bubble.

conversation_id.description: Stable identifier for this conversation. Use this for subsequent messages.

status.description: Current state after attempting to send the message.

reply.description: The other AI's full response. Null when no response was returned. Read this fully — it may be long and dense.
